company.name: Origin
company.shortDescription: Origin is a financial planning platform that manages compensation, benefits, and personal finances for employees.
company.description: Origin was founded on the belief that financial planning should be accessible to everyone at every stage of life. Origin is the first comprehensive employee financial wellness platform for the modern workforce. Its integrated solution helps employees manage compensation, benefits, and personal finances in a single place – side-by-side with financial professionals. Origin is the first platform that combines human financial planners with cutting-edge financial technology that both educates employees and allows them to create, execute, and track their personalized financial plans.

productsAndServices.description: A web and mobile financial planning platform that consolidates personal financial data and provides tools for spending analysis, investing, forecasting, and financial guidance.
productsAndServices.name: Origin Financial Planning Platform

productsAndServices.description: A financial scenario-planning tool that projects net worth, cash flow, and retirement readiness based on connected finances, goals, and changes in income, spending, taxes, and investments.

productsAndServices.description: Personalized financial planning and investment advisory services delivered through Origin Investment Advisory LLC, including guidance from financial planners or the Origin AI Advisor.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $56,000,000, or 77.78% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,571,784 to $400,000,000, a 71.79x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 77 (-6 over 90 days) and market heat at 70 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include GuideVine, Nudge, LearnLux.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
